rows.text: A hash map uses chaining or open addressing to handle collisions. Chaining stores multiple entries in a linked list at the same index. Open addressing finds another open slot nearby when a collision occurs. Both methods ensure efficient data retrieval despite hash collisions.

rows.text: TCP is connection oriented and guarantees delivery while UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery. TCP is slower but more reliable while UDP is faster but less reliable.
